response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT sf.sentreg, sf.instownpct, tr.ordertypedist FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND sf.instownpct IS NOT NULL), mix_baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS mix_baseline FROM units GROUP BY ordertypedist), overall_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM units), kept_units AS (SELECT u.instownpct, mb.mix_baseline, oa.overall_avg FROM units u CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oa JOIN mix_baselines mb ON u.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist WHERE u.instownpct > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_kept_ownership, AVG(instownpct / mix_baseline) AS avg_ownership_ratio, AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM kept_units;
